name: Gemma 4 model overview
notes: Documents the four Gemma 4 architectures (small PLE-based, dense 31B, MoE 26B A4B, unified 12B), the per-size inference memory table, and that every Gemma 4 size ships an MTP draft model for speculative decoding. States all 26B of the A4B model must be resident for fast routing.
